title: Visit Us
intro: Welcome to the Gallery of the Natural History Museum on Mali Kalemegdan. Explore the current exhibition, meet our collection, and take a piece of the story home.

featured.title: Come to Kalemegdan
featured.address: Gallery of the Natural History Museum · Mali Kalemegdan 5, Belgrade

destinations.title: Museum Gallery
destinations.description: Exhibition venue on Mali Kalemegdan — a historic 19th-century building, refurbished in 1994.

destinations.title: Current exhibition
destinations.description: Lords of the Depths — Sharks and Rays of the Adriatic. Co-produced with the Natural History Museum of Montenegro; on view through June 2026.

destinations.title: Tickets
destinations.description: Individual, family, and guided-tour tickets. Free admission Thursday 10am–12pm.

destinations.title: Shop
destinations.description: Catalogues, guides, monographs, and souvenirs from the museum's collections.
